title: Q3 Proposal Candidate Live Lookup Boundary
purpose: Remove the shared C01 mechanism by preventing explicit proposal/candidate patch records from participating as live authority candidates in generic lookup without a governed lifecycle transition.
summary: This patch adds lifecycle-aware fail-closed filtering for proposal/candidate patch records in generic live-authority lookup. Proposal/candidate records remain preserved and traceable, while C02/C03/C04 lifecycle semantics remain untouched.
